name: smwsprites-goombaround
title: Goombaround
description:
Goombaround will walk around until it finds a map16 tile that is not $25, and then go back and forth around it. When it turns around, it switches between being in the "foreground" and being in the "background".

Goombaround will still hurt Mario while in "background" mode if there's no "scenery" between them.

Goombaround uses the same graphics as the standard, in-game Goomba.
